## Introduction

Cette section presente l'analyse approfondie des donnees nucleaires mondiales : tendances temporelles, correlations economiques, visualisations avancees et flux commerciaux internationaux.

## Chargement des packages
```{webr-r}

#| label: setup

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(stringr)
library(scales)
library(DT)
```

## Chargement des donnees nettoyees
```{webr-r}

#| label: import-nuclear

# Importation
df <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/nuclear_production_clean.csv")
nuclear_energy <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/nuclear_production_clean.csv")
energy_stats <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/energy_stats_clean.csv")
gdp_clean <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/gdp_clean.csv")
merged_final <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/merged_final.csv")
wei_clean <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/wei_clean.csv")
nuclear_trade <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/nuclear_trade_clean.csv")
merged_nuclear_energy <- read_csv("outputs/clean_data/merged_nuclear_energy.csv")

cat("📊 Donnees chargees avec succes\n")
cat("• Production nucleaire :", nrow(nuclear_energy), "lignes\n")
cat("• Dataset final fusionne :", nrow(merged_final), "lignes\n")
cat("• Investissements WEI :", nrow(wei_clean), "lignes\n")
cat("• Commerce nucleaire :", nrow(nuclear_trade), "lignes\n")
cat("• merged nuclear energy :", nrow(merged_nuclear_energy), "lignes\n")
```

## 1. Production Nucleaire Mondiale

### 1.1 Evolution temporelle globale
```{webr-r}

#| label: Evolution temporelle globale

# AJOUTEZ CETTE LIGNE ⬇️
library(dplyr)

# Calcul de la production mondiale par annee
global_production <- nuclear_energy %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Production = sum(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    Country_Count = n_distinct(Country),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Graphique d'evolution
ggplot(global_production, aes(x = Year, y = Total_Production)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.5) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution de la Production Nucleaire Mondiale",
    subtitle = "Production totale en TWh",
    x = "Annee",
    y = "Production (TWh)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )
```

### 1.2 Production nucléaire moyenne mondiale
```{webr-r}

#| label: Production nucléaire moyenne mondiale

# AJOUTEZ CETTE LIGNE ⬇️
library(dplyr)

# Production nucléaire moyenne mondiale
global_stats <- global_production %>%
  summarise(
    Production_Moyenne = mean(Total_Production),
    Production_Max = max(Total_Production),
    Annee_Max = Year[which.max(Total_Production)],
    Croissance_2020 = (Total_Production[Year == 2020] - Total_Production[Year == 2000]) / Total_Production[Year == 2000] * 100
  )

kable(global_stats, digits = 2, 
      col.names = c("Moyenne (TWh)", "Maximum (TWh)", "Annee Max", "Croissance 2000-2020 (%)"))
```

### 1.3 Top 10 des producteurs mondiaux
```{webr-r}

#| label: top10-producers

# AJOUTEZ CETTE LIGNE ⬇️
library(dplyr)

# Calcul des totaux par pays
top_producers <- nuclear_energy %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Production = sum(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    Annees_Production = sum(Nuclear_TWh > 0),
    Production_Moyenne = mean(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Production)) %>%
  head(10)

# Graphique en barres horizontales
ggplot(top_producers, aes(x = reorder(Country, Total_Production), y = Total_Production)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "orange", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Total_Production, 0)), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Producteurs Nucleaires (Total historique)",
    x = "",
    y = "Production Totale (TWh)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

<!-- CONTINUEZ CE PATTERN POUR TOUS LES AUTRES BLOCS -->

### 1.4 Distribution regionale
```{webr-r}

#| label: regional-distribution

# AJOUTEZ CETTE LIGNE ⬇️
library(dplyr)

# Definition des regions
regional_production <- nuclear_energy %>%
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Country %in% c("United States", "Canada", "Mexico") ~ "Amerique du Nord",
      Country %in% c("France", "Germany", "United Kingdom", "Spain", "Sweden", "Ukraine", "Russia") ~ "Europe",
      Country %in% c("China", "Japan", "South Korea", "India") ~ "Asie",
      Country %in% c("Argentina", "Brazil") ~ "Amerique du Sud",
      TRUE ~ "Autres"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Year, Region) %>%
  summarise(Production = sum(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Graphique empile
ggplot(regional_production, aes(x = Year, y = Production, fill = Region)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.8, position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Repartition Regionale de la Production Nucleaire 1885-2020",
    x = "Annee",
    y = "Production (TWh)",
    fill = "Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## 2. Analyse du Mix Energetique
### 2.1 Evolution des leaders mondiaux

```{webr-r}

#| label: leaders-evolution

### 2.1 Production mondiale par source d'energie
```{webr-r}

#| label: energy-mix-global

# Filtrage des principales sources
if ("category" %in% names(energy_stats)) {
  main_sources <- energy_stats %>%
    filter(category %in% c(
      "nuclear_electricity",
      "hydro_electricity",
      "solar_electricity",
      "wind_electricity",
      "natural_gas",
      "coal"
    ))
  
  # Aggregation mondiale par annee et source
  global_energy_mix <- main_sources %>%
    group_by(Year, category) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Quantity = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Graphique empile
  ggplot(global_energy_mix, aes(x = Year, y = Total_Quantity, fill = category)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.8, position = "fill") +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
    labs(
      title = "Evolution du Mix Energetique Mondial",
      subtitle = "Part relative de chaque source d'energie",
      x = "Annee",
      y = "Part de la production",
      fill = "Source d'energie"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```
### 2.2 Part du nucleaire dans la production mondiale
```{webr-r}

#| label: nuclear-share-global

if ("category" %in% names(energy_stats)) {
  # Calcul de la part du nucleaire
  nuclear_share <- energy_stats %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Energy = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
      Nuclear_Energy = sum(quantity[category == "nuclear_electricity"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Nuclear_Share = ifelse(Total_Energy > 0, (Nuclear_Energy / Total_Energy) * 100, NA)
    )
  
  # Graphique d'evolution
  ggplot(nuclear_share, aes(x = Year, y = Nuclear_Share)) +
    geom_line(color = "#2E86AB", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(color = "#A23B72", size = 2.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "#F18F01", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "Part du Nucleaire dans la Production Energetique Mondiale",
      x = "Annee",
      y = "Part (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```
### 2.3 Mix énergétique total de la France

```{webr-r}

#| label: france-analysis

# Filtrer les données pour la France
energy_france <- merged_nuclear_energy %>% 
  filter(Country == "France")

# Agrégation par catégorie
classement_categories <- energy_france %>% 
  group_by(category) %>% 
  summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(total_quantity))

# Graphique en barres horizontales
ggplot(classement_categories, aes(x = reorder(category, total_quantity), y = total_quantity, fill = category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(total_quantity, 0)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Production Énergétique par Catégorie - France",
    x = "Catégorie",
    y = "Quantité Totale (TWh)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

```
### 2.4 Évolution mondiale par source d'énergie (TWh)

```{webr-r}

#| label: Évolution mondiale par source d'énergie

# Définir les sources d'énergie
sources <- c('nuclear_electricity', 'hydro', 'solar_electricity', 'wind_electricity')

# Préparer un graphique pour l'évolution mondiale par source
ggplot() +
  lapply(sources, function(source) {
    sub <- merged_nuclear_energy %>% filter(category == source) %>%
      group_by(Year) %>%
      summarise(total_quantity = sum(quantity, na.rm = TRUE))
    geom_line(data = sub, aes(x = Year, y = total_quantity, color = source))
  }) +
  labs(title = "Évolution mondiale par source d'énergie (TWh)",
       x = "Année",
       y = "TWh") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("nuclear_electricity"="red", 
                                "hydro"="blue", 
                                "solar_electricity"="orange", 
                                "wind_electricity"="green"))
```

#| label: energy-investments

# Verification des colonnes disponibles

    select(Year, Nuclear, Renewables, Fossil = `Fossil-fuels`) %>%

## 5. Commerce Nucleaire International
### 5.1 Principaux flux commerciaux
```{webr-r}

#| label: nuclear-trade-analysis

if (nrow(nuclear_trade) > 0) {
  # Top exportateurs
  top_exporters <- nuclear_trade %>%
    filter(FLOW == "Export") %>%
    group_by(REPORTER) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Export = sum(`VALUE USD`, na.rm = TRUE),
      Transaction_Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Export)) %>%
    head(10)
  
  # Graphique exportateurs
  ggplot(top_exporters, aes(x = reorder(REPORTER, Total_Export), y = Total_Export)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#118AB2", alpha = 0.8) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    labs(
      title = "Top 10 Exportateurs Nucleaires",
      x = "",
      y = "Valeur exportee (USD)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  # Tableau des exportateurs
  cat("\n📤 Top 5 exportateurs :\n")
  kable(head(top_exporters, 5), digits = 0,
        format.args = list(big.mark = " "),
        col.names = c("Pays", "Valeur exportee (USD)", "Nombre transactions"))
}
```
### 5.2 Relations commerciales bilaterales
```{webr-r}

#| label: bilateral-trade

if (nrow(nuclear_trade) > 0) {
  # Top importateurs
  top_importers <- nuclear_trade %>%
    filter(FLOW == "Import") %>%
    group_by(REPORTER) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Import = sum(`VALUE USD`, na.rm = TRUE),
      Transaction_Count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Import)) %>%
    head(10)
  
  # Calcul des flux bilateraux
  bilateral_flows <- nuclear_trade %>%
    group_by(REPORTER, PARTNER, FLOW) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Value = sum(`VALUE USD`, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = FLOW, values_from = Total_Value, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      Trade_Balance = Export - Import,
      Total_Trade = Export + Import
    )
  
  # Top relations commerciales
  top_relationships <- bilateral_flows %>%
    arrange(desc(Total_Trade)) %>%
    head(10)
  
  cat("\n🤝 Top 10 relations commerciales nucleaires :\n")
  kable(top_relationships, digits = 0,
        format.args = list(big.mark = " "),
        col.names = c("Exportateur", "Importateur", "Export (USD)", "Import (USD)", "Balance (USD)", "Total (USD)"))
}
```
## 6. Indicateurs de Performance
```{webr-r}

#| label: performance-index

# Calcul d'un indice composite
performance_index <- nuclear_energy %>%
  group_by(Country) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Production = sum(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE),
    Years_Active = sum(Nuclear_TWh > 0),
    Production_Growth = ifelse(
      !is.na(Nuclear_TWh[Year == min(Year)]) && Nuclear_TWh[Year == min(Year)] > 0,
      (Nuclear_TWh[Year == max(Year)] - Nuclear_TWh[Year == min(Year)]) / 
      Nuclear_TWh[Year == min(Year)] * 100,
      NA
    ),
    Production_Stability = ifelse(
      mean(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      sd(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(Nuclear_TWh, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Total_Production > 0 & !is.na(Production_Growth) & !is.na(Production_Stability)) %>%
  mutate(
    Score_Production = scale(Total_Production),
    Score_Experience = scale(Years_Active),
    Score_Growth = scale(Production_Growth),
    Score_Stability = scale(-Production_Stability),
    Performance_Index = (Score_Production + Score_Experience + Score_Growth + Score_Stability) / 4
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Performance_Index))

# Top 15 par performance
top_performers <- head(performance_index, 15)

ggplot(top_performers, aes(x = reorder(Country, Performance_Index), y = Performance_Index)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "#F18F01", alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Indice de Performance Nucleaire par Pays",
    subtitle = "Indice composite : production, experience, croissance, stabilite",
    x = "",
    y = "Score de performance (standardise)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40")
  )

cat("🏆 Top 10 pays par indice de performance nucleaire :\n")
kable(head(performance_index, 10) %>% select(Country, Total_Production, Years_Active, Performance_Index),
      digits = 2,
      col.names = c("Pays", "Production Totale (TWh)", "Annees actives", "Score Performance"))
```

## 8. Synthese et Tableau de Bord
```{webr-r}

#| label: summary-dashboard

# Calcul des indicateurs cles
total_countries <- length(unique(nuclear_energy$Country[nuclear_energy$Nuclear_TWh > 0]))
leader_country <- top_producers$Country[1]
leader_production <- round(top_producers$Total_Production[1], 0)

# Tableau recapitulatif
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Indicateur = c(
    "Production mondiale 2022 (TWh)",
    "Part mondiale du nucleaire (%)",
    "Nombre de pays producteurs",
    "Croissance 2000-2022 (%)",
    "Pays leader (production)",
    "Production leader (TWh)",
    "Investissement nucleaire 2023 (milliards USD)"
  ),
  Valeur = c(
    round(global_production$Total_Production[global_production$Year == max(global_production$Year)], 0),
    if (exists("nuclear_share")) {
      round(nuclear_share$Nuclear_Share[nuclear_share$Year == max(nuclear_share$Year)], 1)
    } else "NA",
    total_countries,
    if (nrow(global_production) > 0) {
      latest_year <- max(global_production$Year)
      base_year <- 2000
      if (base_year %in% global_production$Year && latest_year %in% global_production$Year) {
        growth <- (global_production$Total_Production[global_production$Year == latest_year] - 
                   global_production$Total_Production[global_production$Year == base_year]) / 
                  global_production$Total_Production[global_production$Year == base_year] * 100
        round(growth, 1)
      } else "NA"
    } else "NA",
    leader_country,
    leader_production,
    if ("Nuclear" %in% names(wei_clean)) {
      latest_invest <- max(wei_clean$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
      round(wei_clean$Nuclear[wei_clean$Year == latest_invest], 1)
    } else "NA"
  )
)

kable(summary_stats, 
      caption = "Tableau de Bord - Energie Nucleaire Mondiale",
      col.names = c("Indicateur", "Valeur"))

# Graphique de synthese
cat("\n📊 Tableau recapitulatif des datasets :\n")

summary_df <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c(
    "Production nucleaire",
    "Statistiques energetiques",
    "PIB (pays uniquement)",
    "Dataset fusionne final",
    "Investissements WEI",
    "Commerce nucleaire"
  ),
  Lignes = c(
    nrow(nuclear_energy),
    nrow(energy_stats),
    nrow(gdp_clean),
    nrow(merged_final),
    nrow(wei_clean),
    nrow(nuclear_trade)
  ),
  Colonnes = c(
    ncol(nuclear_energy),
    ncol(energy_stats),
    ncol(gdp_clean),
    ncol(merged_final),
    ncol(wei_clean),
    ncol(nuclear_trade)
  ),
  Période = c(
    paste(min(nuclear_energy$Year), "-", max(nuclear_energy$Year)),
    paste(min(energy_stats$Year), "-", max(energy_stats$Year)),
    paste(min(gdp_clean$Year), "-", max(gdp_clean$Year)),
    paste(min(merged_final$Year), "-", max(merged_final$Year)),
    paste(min(wei_clean$Year), "-", max(wei_clean$Year)),
    if (nrow(nuclear_trade) > 0) {
      paste(min(nuclear_trade$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(nuclear_trade$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else "NA"
  )
)

kable(summary_df, 
      caption = "Resume des datasets utilises",
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "c"))
```
<script type="module">
import { WebR } from 'https://webr.r-wasm.org/latest/webr.mjs';
const webR = new WebR();
await webR.init();

document.querySelectorAll('.webr-code').forEach(block => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.textContent = '▶ Exécuter';
  btn.onclick = async () => {
    const code = block.textContent;
    const output = await webR.evalR(code);
    console.log(output);
  };
  block.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, block);
});
</script>
